title: Paper storm
technique: Thousands of copies of a printed sheet are placed and turned by one shader that arranges them into formations.
music: The bar turns the formations and the beat flips sheets, changes pages and steps the falling paper. Each kick drum throws things outward and sends an amber shockwave ring through the paper, while overall loudness brightens the lamp and glow.

takes.description: A flight down a tube of printed sheets (blueprints, star charts and pink tickets) towards a marble bust in a dark void, with a ring of sheets flipping to a red reverse on each beat.

takes.name: Board
takes.description: A flat wall of sheets seen square-on, where sheets turned to their yellow reverse spell short three-line phrases in pixel letters and a new phrase flaps in every two beats.
words: EVERY SHEET IS A PIXEL OF THIS TEXT
KICK DRUM SENDS A RING OUT

takes.name: Murmuration
takes.description: The sheets become dark silhouettes folding like a flock of birds in a pale cream sky, with the bust small beneath them and no readable text.
words: INSTANCING: 6144 PAPER SHEETS, EACH ONE PLACED BY A SHADER.
THREE SINE WAVES FOLD THE FLOCK. BASS DEEPENS THE FOLDS.

takes.name: Ritual
takes.description: No paper at all: rings of rubber ducks, a fence of brass keys that fall like dominoes, traffic cones and amphorae turn around a gold lunar lander on a red background, seen low and close with soft focus.
words: INSTANCING: 196 OBJECTS, EACH ONE PLACED BY A SHADER.
DUCKS HOP IN A WAVE ON THE BEAT. A KICK DRUM THROWS THE KEYS.

takes.name: Floor
takes.description: A view straight down on a tidy floor of printed sheets drawn in chunky black-and-white pixels, where a ring of sheets turning to black spreads out every two beats.
words: INSTANCING: A FLOOR OF 6144 SHEETS, DRAWN IN 1-BIT DITHER.
EVERY 2 BEATS A RING OF SHEETS TURNS OVER TO BLACK.

takes.name: One sheet
takes.description: A single large sheet turns close to the camera, sharp and readable, while the whole swirl of paper is a red and blue blur far behind it.
words: This sheet is one flat model: two triangles. The blur behind it is 6144 copies of the model, arranged in a spiral by one shader. The shader writes one pixel per copy: its position and which way it faces. The bar turns the spiral. Each kick drum tips this sheet back.
TOUCHDESIGNER   GEOMETRY COMP INSTANCING FROM A GLSL TOP

as_processor: Prints the picture on every one of 6144 instanced paper sheets (and as a two-colour print on their reverses), then flies, drops or rings them to the music; on the board take the wall of 96 x 64 sheets becomes a flip-dot display of the picture.
